title: gallery_arm still quietly substitutes the baseline font for a failed candidate — contradicting the PR's 'quiet-fallback lie is impossible now'
detail: A failed candidate load still writes baseline-rendered frames under the candidate's tag in bin/gallery/<tag>/; graders read PNGs, not stderr. font_check treats the identical failure as fatal — inconsistent policies for the same hazard.
recommended_fix: Exit non-zero on candidate-load failure (mirror font_check), or write the captures under a 'baseline' tag so artifacts cannot misrepresent the family.

title: ci-local.sh: gate count bumped to 13 in the header but the identical usage line inside the script still says 'all 10 gates'
evidence:
-#   tools/ci-local.sh                 # all 10 gates in a linux container (the ubuntu leg)
+#   tools/ci-local.sh                 # all 13 gates in a linux container (the ubuntu leg)
---
   tools/ci-local.sh                 # all 10 gates in a linux container (the ubuntu leg)
   tools/ci-local.sh --fast          # gates 1-2 only (lint + unit tests — the 10-second loop)
-  tools/ci-local.sh --mac           # the same 10 gates natively on macOS
+  tools/ci-local.sh --mac           # the same 13 gates natively on macOS
detail: The same sentence exists twice; one copy was updated to 13, the copy in the script's usage block was missed — classic one-place-updated drift.
recommended_fix: Update the usage block's first line to 'all 13 gates' (or derive both from GATES length).

title: font_merge_fallback completeness-failure path frees only `merged` — the `glyphs` and `fg` array blocks leak
detail: The early return skips the two MemFree calls shown immediately below it, leaking both source arrays (and their glyph image data) — contradicting the file's exact-once ownership doctrine on its own error path.
recommended_fix: Free glyphs and fg before the completeness-failure return (and free merged entries' image data or document why not).

title: font_test pins unload only the atlas image — the glyph array and f.recs are dropped unfreed
evidence:
+	_, atlas, ok := font_atlas_build_from_file(FONT_ASSET)
+	if ok {
+		rl.UnloadImage(atlas) // note (r4): the guard test discards the atlas — free it
+	}
---
+	mono, am, okm := font_atlas_build_from_file(FONT_MONO_ASSET)
...
+	defer rl.UnloadImage(am)
detail: font_atlas_build assigns glyphs and GenImageFontAtlas-allocated recs into the returned Font; both tests discard it. font_probe_warning in the same file MemFree's glyphs — the discipline is applied inconsistently.
recommended_fix: Also MemFree the glyph arrays (and the recs blocks) in both tests, matching font_probe_warning's teardown.

title: NOC section label raised 10px→12px but the divider rule stays at y+13 — descenders may now touch the rule
evidence:
-		draw_text_c(v, label, NOC_PANEL_X + 6, y, 10, NOC_LABEL)
+		draw_mono_c(v, label, NOC_PANEL_X + 6, y, 12, NOC_LABEL)
 		rl.DrawLine(NOC_PANEL_X + 6, y + 13, NOC_PANEL_X + NOC_PANEL_W - 6, y + 13, rl.Color{255, 255, 255, 24})
detail: The label grew 2px downward while the rule offset is unchanged; at 12px the glyph box + descender can reach or cross y+13, striking through lowercase text.

title: font_check claims 'the same recipe as the shipped load_font_file' but loads candidates via plain LoadFontEx (no fallback merge, 0 padding)
evidence:
+	// 1. load the candidate at the app's atlas size (the same recipe as
+	// the shipped load_font_file — a failed load is FATAL, never a silent
+	// fallback-font specimen). `warn_font` is the same family loaded WITH
+	f := rl.LoadFontEx(strings.clone_to_cstring(font_path, context.temp_allocator), rnd.FONT_BASE_SIZE, nil, 0)
---
+FONT_GLYPH_PADDING :: 4 // the atlas packing padding (OUR choice — raylib's LoadFontEx itself packs with 0; 4px keeps adjacent glyph bitmaps from bleeding under bilinear filtering)
detail: The shipped path builds a merged fallback atlas with 4px padding over 96 codepoints; the candidate path uses LoadFontEx (0 padding, default charset, no merge). A/B frames don't exercise the shipped rasterization.
recommended_fix: Load candidates through font_atlas_build_from_file's merge path, or correct the comment to say the recipe differs.
